target: the world-illuming sun of yearning shineth, and the fire of love is ablaze

source: چون نار عشق بر افروخت خرمن عقل بكلی بسوخت
target: when the fire of love is ablaze, it burneth to ashes the harvest of reason

source: در اين وقت سالك از خود و از غير خود بيخبر است
target: Now is the traveler unaware of himself, and of aught besides himself

source: نه جهل و علم داند و نه شك و يقين
target: He seeth neither ignorance nor knowledge, neither doubt nor certitude

source: نه صبح هدايت شناسد و نه شام ضلالت
target: he knoweth not the morn of guidance from the night of error

source: از كفر و ايمان هر دو در گريز
target: He fleeth both from unbelief and faith
deadly poison is a balm to him

source: كفر كافر را و دين ديندار را
target: For the infidel, error - for the faithful, faith
For Attar's heart, an atom of Thy pain.
The steed of this Valley is pain

source: اگر درد نباشد هر گز اين سفر تمام نشود
target: if there be no pain this journey will never end

source: عاشق در اين رتبه جز معشوق خيالی ندارد
target: In this station the lover hath no thought save the Beloved
seeketh no refuge save the Friend

source: در هر آن صد جان رايگان در ره جانان دهد
target: At every moment he offereth a hundred lives in the path of the Loved One

source: در هر قدمی هزار سر در پای دوست اندازد
target: at every step he throweth a thousand heads at the feet of the Beloved

source: ای برادر من تا بمصر عشق در نيائی بيوسف جمال دوست واصل نشوی
target: O My Brother! Until thou enter the Egypt of love, thou shalt never come to the Joseph of the Beauty of the Friend

source: تا چون يعقوب از چشم ظاهری نگذری چشم باطن نگشائی
target: until, like Jacob, thou forsake thine outward eyes, thou shalt never open the eye of thine inward being

source: تا بنار عشق نيفروزی بيار شوق نياميزی
target: until thou burn with the fire of love, thou shalt never commune with the Lover of Longing

source: عاشق را از هيچ چيز پروا نيست

target: no harm can come nigh him

source: از نار سردش بينی و از دريا خشكش يابی
target: Thou seest him chill in the fire and dry in the sea

source: نشان عاشق آن باشد كه سردش بينی از دوزخ
target: A lover is he who is chill in hell fire

source: نشان عارف آن باشد كه خشكش بينی از دريا
target: A knower is he who is dry in the sea

source: عشق هستی قبول نكند و زندگی نخواهد
target: Love accepteth no existence and wisheth no life

source: حيات در ممات بيند و عزّت از ذلّت جويد
target: He seeth life in death, and in shame seeketh glory

source: بسيار هوش بايد تا لايق جوش عشق شود
target: To merit the madness of love, man must abound in sanity

source: بسيار سر بايد تا قابل كمند دوست گردد
target: to merit the bonds of the Friend, he must be full of spirit.

source: مبارك گردنی كه در كمندش افتد
target: Blessed the neck that is caught in His noose

source: فرخنده سری كه در راه محبّتش بخاك افتد
target: happy the head that falleth on the dust in the pathway of His love

source: پس ای دوست از نفس بيگانه شو تا بيگانه پی بری
target: Wherefore, O friend, give up thy self that thou mayest find the Peerless One

source: از خاكدان فانی بگذر تا در آشيان الهی جای گيری
target: pass by this mortal earth that thou mayest seek a home in the nest of heaven

source: نيستی بايد تا نار هستی بر افروزی و مقبول راه عشق شوی
target: Be as naught, if thou wouldst kindle the fire of being and be fit for the pathway of love
Love seizeth not upon a living soul
The falcon preyeth not on a dead mouse

source: عشق در هر آنی عالمی بسوزد
target: Love setteth a world aflame at every turn

source: در هر ديار كه علم بر افرازد ويران سازد
target: he wasteth every land where he carrieth his banner.

source: در مملكتش هستی را وجودی نه
target: Being hath no existence in his kingdom
the wise wield no command within his realm

source: نهنگ عشق اديب عقل را ببلعد و لبيب دانش بشگرد
target: The leviathan of love swalloweth the master of reason and destroyeth the lord of knowledge

source: هفت دريا بياشامد وعطش قلبش نيفسرد
target: He drinketh the seven seas, but his heart's thirst is still unquenched
he saith, "Is there yet any more?"

source: ازهر چه در عالم است كناره گيرد
target: draweth away from all on earth

source: با دو عالم عشق را بيگانگی
target: Love's a stranger to earth and heaven too

source: اندر او هفتاد و دو ديوانگی
صد هزار مظلومان در كمندش بسته
target: He hath bound a myriad victims in his fetters

source: صد هزار عارفان به تيرش خسته
target: wounded a myriad wise men with his arrow

source: هر سرخی كه در عالم بينی از قهرش دان
target: Know that every redness in the world is from his anger

source: هر زردی كه در رخسار بينی از زهرش شمر
target: every paleness in men's cheeks is from his poison
He yieldeth no remedy but death

source: جز در وادی عدم قدم نگذارد
target: he walketh not save in the valley of the shadow

source: لكن زهرش در كام عاشق از شهد خوشتر
target: yet sweeter than honey is his venom on the lover's lips

source: فنايش در نظر طالب از صد هزار بقا محبوبترست
target: fairer his destruction in the seeker's eyes than a hundred thousand lives

source: پس بايد بنار عشق حجابهای نفس شيطانی سوخته شود تا روح برای ادراك مراتب سيّد " لو لا ك " لطيف و پاكيزه گردد
target: Wherefore must the veils of the satanic self be burned away at the fire of love, that the spirit may be purified and cleansed and thus may know the station of the Lord of the Worlds.

source: نار عشقی بر فروز و جمله هستيها بسوز
target: Kindle the fire of love and burn away all things,

source: پس قدم بردار و اندر كوی عشّاقان گذار
target: Then set thy foot into the land of the lovers.

source: اگر عاشق بتأييدات خالق از منقار شاهين عشق بسلامت بگذرد
target: if, confirmed by the Creator, the lover escapes from the claws of the eagle of love
he will enter THE VALLEY OF KNOWLEDGE
come out of doubt into certitude

source: از ظلمت ضلالت هوی بنور هدايت تقوی راجع گردد
target: turn from the darkness of illusion to the guiding light of the fear of God

source: با حبيب خود براز مشغول گردد
target: he will privily converse with his Beloved
he will set ajar the gate of truth and piety
and shut the doors of vain imaginings

source: در اين رتبه قضا را رضا دهد
target: He in this station is content with the decree of God

source: در فنا معانی بقا درك نمايد
target: findeth in death the secrets of everlasting life

source: بچشم سَر و سرّ در آفاق ايجاد و انفس عباد اسرار معاد بيند
target: With inward and outward eyes he witnesseth the mysteries of resurrection in the realms of creation and the souls of men

source: حكمت صمدانی را بقلب روحانی در مظاهر نا متناهی الهی سير فرمايد
target: with a pure heart apprehendeth the divine wisdom in the endless Manifestations of God
In the ocean he findeth a drop

source: در قطره اسرار بحر ملاحظه كند
target: in a drop he beholdeth the secrets of the sea

source: دل هر ذرّهٴ كه بشكافی آفتابيش در ميان بينی
target: Split the atom's heart, and lo! Within it thou wilt find a sun

source: سالك در اين وادی در آفرينش حق ببينش مطلق مخالف و مغاير نبيند
target: The wayfarer in this Valley seeth in the fashionings of the True One nothing save clear providence

source: در هر آن " ما تری فی خلق الرّحمن من تفاوت فارجع البصر هل تری من فطور " گويد
target: at every moment saith: "No defect canst thou see in the creation of the God of Mercy: Repeat the gaze: Seest thou a single flaw?"

source: در ظلم عدل بيند و در عدل فضل مشاهده كند
target: He beholdeth justice in injustice, and in justice, grace

source: در جهل علمها مستور بيند و در علمها صد هزار حكمتها آشكار و هويدا ادراك نمايد
target: In ignorance he findeth many a knowledge hidden, and in knowledge a myriad wisdoms manifest

source: قفس تن و هوی بشكند و بنفس اهل بقا انس گيرد
target: He breaketh the cage of the body and the passions, and consorteth with the people of the immortal realm

source: بنردبانهای معنوی صعود نمايد و بسماء معانی بشتابد
target: He mounteth on the ladders of inner truth and hasteneth to the heaven of inner significance

source: در فُلك " سنريهم آياتنا فی الافاق و فی انفسهم " ساكن شود
target: He rideth in the ark of "we shall show them our signs in the regions and in themselves,"

source: بر بحر " حتّی يتبيّن لهم انّه الحقّ " ساير گردد
target: journeyeth over the sea of "until it become plain to them that (this Book) is the truth."
if he meeteth with injustice he shall have patience
if he cometh upon wrath he shall manifest love

source: حكايت كنند عاشقی سالها در هجر معشوقش جان ميباخت و در آتش فراقش ميگداخت
target: There was once a lover who had sighed for long years in separation from his beloved, and wasted in the fire of remoteness

source: ازغلبه عشق صدرش از صبر خالی ماند و جسمش از روح بيزاری جست
target: From the rule of love, his heart was empty of patience, and his body weary of his spirit

source: زندگی در فراقرا از نفاق ميشمرد و از آفاق بغايت در احتراق بود
target: he reckoned life without her as a mockery, and time consumed him away

source: چه روزها كه از هجرش راحت نجسته و بسا شبها كه از دردش نخفته
target: How many a day he found no rest in longing for her; how many a night the pain of her kept him from sleep

source: از ضعف بدن چون آهی گشته و از درد دل چون وای شده
target: his body was worn to a sigh, his heart's wound had turned him to a cry of sorrow

source: بيك شربهٴ وصلش هزار جان رايگان ميداد و ميسر نميشد
target: He had given a thousand lives for one taste of the cup of her presence, but it availed him not

source: طبيبان از علاجش در ماندند و مؤانسان از انسش دوری جستند
target: The doctors knew no cure for him, and companions avoided his company

source: بلی مريض عشق را طبيب چاره نداند
target: yea, physicians have no medicine for one sick of love
unless the favor of the beloved one deliver him

source: باری عاقبت شجر رجايش ثمر يأس بخشيد و نار اميدش بيفسرد
target: At last, the tree of his longing yielded the fruit of despair, and the fire of his hope fell to ashes

source: تا آنكه شبی از جان بيزار شد و از خانه ببازار رفت
target: Then one night he could live no more, and he went out of his house and made for the marketplace

source: ناگاه او را عسسی تعاقب نمود
target: On a sudden, a watchman followed after him

source: او از پيش تازان و عسس از پی دوان
target: He broke into a run, with the watchman following

source: تا آنكه عسسها جمع شدند و از هر طرف راه فرار برآن بيقرار بستند
target: then other watchmen came together, and barred every passage to the weary one

source: آن فقير از دل ميناليد و باطراف ميدويد و با خود ميگفت اين عسس عزرائيل من است كه باين تعجيل در طلب من است و
target: And the wretched one cried from his heart, and ran here and there, and moaned to himself: "Surely this watchman is Izra'il, my angel of death, following so fast upon me;

source: يا شدّاد بلادست كه در كين عباد است
target: or he is a tyrant of men, seeking to harm me."

source: آن خسته تير عشق بپا دوان بود و بدل نالان
target: His feet carried him on, the one bleeding with the arrow of love, and his heart lamented

source: تا بديوار باغی رسيد و بهزار زحمت و محنت بالای ديوار رفت
target: Then he came to a garden wall, and with untold pain he scaled it

source: ديواری بغايت بلند ديد از جان گذشت و خود را در باغ انداخت
target: for it proved very high; and forgetting his life, he threw himself down to the garden.

source: ديد معشوقش در دست چراغی دارد و تفحص انگشتری مينمايد كه از او گم شده بود
target: And there he beheld his beloved with a lamp in her hand, searching for a ring she had lost

source: ديد معشوقش در دست چراغی دارد و تفحص انگشتری مينمايد كه از او گم شده بود
target: nd there he beheld his beloved with a lamp in her hand, searching for a ring she had lost.

source: چون آن عاشق دلداده معشوق دل برده را ديد آهی بر كشيد و دست بدعا بر داشت كه ای خدا اين عسس را عزّت ده و دولت بخش و باقی دار
target: And there he beheld his beloved with a lamp in her hand, searching for a ring she had lost

source: چون آن عاشق دلداده معشوق دل برده را ديد آهی بر كشيد و دست بدعا بر داشت كه ای خدا اين عسس را عزّت ده و دولت بخش و باقی دار
target: When the heart-surrendered lover looked on his ravishing love, he drew a great breath and raised up his hands in prayer, crying: "O God! Give Thou glory to the watchman, and riches and long life

source: كه اين عسس جبرئيل بود كه دليل اين عليل گشت يا اسرافيل بود كه حيات بخش اين ذليل شد
target: For the watchman was Gabriel, guiding this poor one; or he was Israfil, bringing life to this wretched one!"

source: آنچه گفت فی الحقيقه درست بود زيرا ملاحظه شد كه اين ظلم منكَر عسس چقدر عدلها در سر داشت و چه رحمتها در پرده پنهان نموده بود
target: Indeed, his words were true, for he had found many a secret justice in this seeming tyranny of the watchman, and seen how many a mercy lay hid behind the veil

source: بيك قهر تشنه صحرای عشق را ببحر معشوق واصل نمود
target: Out of wrath, the guard had led him who was athirst in love's desert to the sea of his loved one

source: ظلمت فراق را بنور وصال روشن فرمود
target: lit up the dark night of absence with the light of reunion

source: بعيدی را ببستان قرب جای داد و عليلی را بطبيب قلب راه نمود
target: He had driven one who was afar, into the garden of nearness, had guided an ailing soul to the heart's physician.

source: حال آن عاشق اگر آخر بين بود در اوّل بر عسس رحمت مينمود و دعايش ميگفت و آن ظلم را عدل ميديد
target: Now if the lover could have looked ahead, he would have blessed the watchman at the start, and prayed on his behalf, and he would have seen that tyranny as justice

source: چون از آخر محجوب بود در اوّل ناله آغاز نمود و بشكايت زبان گشود
target: but since the end was veiled to him, he moaned and made his plaint in the beginning

source: لكن مسافران حديقه عرفان چون آخر را در اوّل بينند لهذا در جنگ صلح و در قهر آشتی ملاحظه كنند
target: Yet those who journey in the garden land of knowledge, because they see the end in the beginning, see peace in war and friendliness in anger

source: اين رتبه اهل اين وادی است
target: Such is the state of the wayfarers in this Valley

source: اهل واديهای فوق اين وادی اوّل و آخر را يك بينند بلكه نه اوّل بينند نه آخر لا اوّل و لا آخر بينند
target: but the people of the Valleys above this see the end and the beginning as one; nay, they see neither beginning nor end, and witness neither "first" nor "last."

source: بلكه اهل مدينهٴ بقا كه در روضهٴ خضرا ساكنند لا اوّل و لا آخر هم نبينند از اولها در گريزند و باخرها در ستيز
target: Nay rather, the denizens of the undying city, who dwell in the green garden land, see not even "neither first nor last"; they fly from all that is first, and repulse all that is last

source: زيرا كه عوالم اسما را طی نموده‌اند و از عوالم صفات چون برق در گذشته‌اند
target: For these have passed over the worlds of names, and fled beyond the worlds of attributes as swift as lightning.

source: چنانچه ميفرمايد " كمال التّوحيد نفی الصّفات عنه "
target: Thus is it said: "Absolute Unity excludeth all attributes."
And they have made their dwelling-place in the shadow of the Essence

source: اينست كه خواجه عبداللّه قدّس اللّه تعالی سرّه العزيز در اين مقام نكتهٴ دقيقی و كلمهٴ بليغی در معنی " اهد نا الصّراط المستقيم " فرموده‌اند
target: Wherefore, relevant to this, Khajih Abdu'llah - may God the Most High sanctify his beloved spirit - hath made a subtle point and spoken an eloquent word as to the meaning of "Guide Thou us on the straight path,"

source: و آن اينست كه " بنمای بما راه راست يعنی بمحبت ذات خود مشرف دار تا از التفات بخود و غير تو آزاد گشته بتمامی گرفتار تو گرديم جز تو ندانيم جز تو نبينيم و جز تو نينديشيم "
target: which is: "Show us the right way, that is, honor us with the love of Thine Essence, that we may be freed from turning toward ourselves and toward all else save Thee, and may become wholly Thine, and know only Thee, and see only Thee, and think of none save Thee."

source: بلكه از اين مقام هم بالا روند چنانچه ميفرمايد " المحبّة حجاب بين المحبّ و المحبوب "
target: Nay, these even mount above this station, wherefore it is said: Love is a veil betwixt the lover and the loved one;

source: بيش از اين گفتن مرا دستور نيست
target: More than this I am not permitted to tell.

source: در اين وقت صبح معرفت طالع شد و چراغهای سير و سلوك خاموش گشت
target: At this hour the morn of knowledge hath arisen and the lamps of wayfaring and wandering are quenched

source: وهم موسی با همه نور و هنر شد از آن محجوب تو بی پر مپر
target: Veiled from this was Moses Though all strength and light; Then thou who hast no wings at all, Attempt not flight.

source: اگر اهل راز و نيازی بپرهای همت اوليا پرواز كن
target: If thou be a man of communion and prayer, soar up on the wings of assistance from Holy Souls

source: تا اسرار دوست بينی و بانوار محبوب رسی
target: that thou mayest behold the mysteries of the Friend and attain to the lights of the Beloved

source: انّا للّه و انّا اليه راجعون
target: "Verily, we are from God and to Him shall we return."

source: سالك بعد از سير وادی معرفت كه آخر مقام تحديد است باول مقام توحيد واصل شود
target: After passing through the Valley of knowledge, which is the last plane of limitation, the wayfarer cometh to THE VALLEY OF UNITY
drinketh from the cup of the Absolute
gazeth on the Manifestations of Oneness

source: در اين مقام حجاب كثرت بر درد
target: In this station he pierceth the veils of plurality
fleeth from the worlds of the flesh
ascendeth into the heaven of singleness
With the ear of God he heareth

source: بچشم ربانی اسرار صنع صمدانی بيند
target: with the eye of God he beholdeth the mysteries of divine creation
He steppeth into the sanctuary of the Friend
shareth as an intimate the pavilion of the Loved One

source: دست حق از جيب مطلق بر آرد
target: He stretcheth out the hand of truth from the sleeve of the Absolute
he revealeth the secrets of power

source: وصف و اسم و رسم از خود نبيند
target: He seeth in himself neither name nor fame nor rank

source: وصف خود را در وصف حق بيند
target: but findeth his own praise in praising God

source: اسم حق را در اسم خود ملاحظه نمايد
target: He beholdeth in his own name the name of God
to him, "all songs are from the King,"

source: جميع نغمات را از او شنود
بر كرسی " قل كلّ من عند اللّه " جالس شود
target: He sitteth on the throne of "Say, all is from God,"

source: بر بساط " لا حول و لا قوّة الّا باللّه " راحت گيرد
target: taketh his rest on the carpet of "There is no power or might but in God."

source: در اشياء بنظر توحيد مشاهده كند
target: He looketh on all things with the eye of oneness

source: اشراق تجلّی شمس الهی را از مشرق هويت بر همه ممكنات يكسان بيند
target: and seeth the brilliant rays of the divine sun shining from the dawning-point of Essence alike on all created things

source: انوار توحيد را بر جميع موجودات موجود و ظاهر مشاهده كند
target: the lights of singleness reflected over all creation

source: معلوم آنجناب بوده كه جميع اختلافات عوالم كون كه در مراتب سلوك سالك مشاهده ميكند از نظر خود سالك است
target: It is clear to thine Eminence that all the variations which the wayfarer in the stages of his journey beholdeth in the realms of being, proceed from his own vision

source: مثالی در اين مقام ذكر ميشود تا اين معنی تمام معلوم گردد
target: We shall give an example of this, that its meaning may become fully clear

source: ملاحظه در شمس ظاهری فرمائيد كه بر همه موجودات و ممكنات بيك اشراق تجلّی مينمايد و افاضه نور بامر سلطان ظهور بر همه اشياء ميفرمايد
target: Consider the visible sun; although it shineth with one radiance upon all things, and at the behest of the King of Manifestation bestoweth light on all creation

source: ليكن در هر محلّ باقتضای استعداد آن محل ظاهر ميشود و اعطای فيض ميكند
target: yet in each place it becometh manifest and sheddeth its bounty according to the potentialities of that place

source: مثل اينكه در مرآت بقرصها و هيأتها جلوه مينمايد
target: For instance, in a mirror it reflecteth its own disk and shape

source: اين بواسطه لطافت خود مرآت است
target: this is due to the sensitivity of the mirror
in a crystal it maketh fire to appear

source: در ساير اشياء همان اثر تجلّی ظاهر است نه قرص
target: in other things it showeth only the effect of its shining, but not its full disk

source: بان اثر هر شیء را بامر مؤثر باستعداد او تربيت ميكند
target: yet, through that effect, by the command of the Creator, it traineth each thing according to the quality of that thing

source: همچنين الوان هم باقتضای محلّ ظاهر ميشود
target: In like manner, colors become visible in every object according to the nature of that object

source: مثل اينكه در زجاجه زرد تجلّی زرد و در سفيد تجلّی سفيد و در سرخ تجلّی سرخ ملاحظه ميشود
target: For instance, in a yellow globe, the rays shine yellow; in a white the rays are white; and in a red, the red rays are manifest.

source: پس اين اختلافات از محلّ است نه از اشراق ضياء
target: Then these variations are from the object, not from the shining light

source: اگر محل مانع داشته باشد مثل جدار و سقف آن محلّ بالمرّه از تجلّی شمس محروم ماند و آفتاب بر آن نتابد
target: And if a place be shut away from the light, as by walls or a roof, it will be entirely bereft of the splendor of the light, nor will the sun shine thereon

source: اين است كه بعضی از نفوس ضعيفه چون اراضی معرفت را بجدار نفس و هوی و حجاب غفلت و عمی حايل نموده‌اند لهذا از اشراق شمس معانی و اسرار محبوب لايزالی محجوب مانده‌اند
target: Thus it is that certain invalid souls have confined the lands of knowledge within the wall of self and passion, and clouded them with ignorance and blindness, and have been veiled from the light of the mystic sun and the mysteries of the Eternal Beloved

source: از جواهر حكمت دين مبين سيّد المرسلين دور مانده‌اند
target: they have strayed afar from the jewelled wisdom of the lucid Faith of the Lord of Messengers

source: از حرم جمال محروم شدند و از كعبه جلال مهجور
target: have been shut out of the sanctuary of the All-Beauteous One, and banished from the Ka'bih of splendor
Such is the worth of the people of this age

source: اگر بلبلی از گِل نفس بر خيزد و بر شاخسار گُل قلب جای گيرد
target: if a nightingale soar upward from the clay of self and dwell in the rose bower of the heart

source: بنغمات حجازی و آوازهای خوش عراقی اسرار الهی ذكر نمايد
target: in Arabian melodies and sweet Iranian songs recount the mysteries of God -

source: كه حرفی از آن جميع جسدهای مرده را حيات تازهٴ جديد بخشد و روح قدسی بر عظام رميمهٴ ممكنات مبذول دارد
target: a single word of which quickeneth to fresh, new life the bodies of the dead, and bestoweth the Holy Spirit upon the moldering bones of this existence

source: هزار چنگال حسد و منقار بغض بينی كه قصد او نمايند
target: thou wilt behold a thousand claws of envy, a myriad beaks of rancor hunting after Him

source: با تمام جدّ در هلاكش كوشند
target: with all their power intent upon His death

source: بلی جُعَل را بوی خوش ناخوش آيد
target: Yea, to the beetle a sweet fragrance seemeth foul,

source: مزكوم را رايحهٴ طيب ثمر ندهد
target: to the man sick of a rheum a pleasant perfume is as naught

source: اينست كه برای ارشاد عوام گفته‌اند
target: Wherefore, it hath been said for the guidance of the ignorant

source: دفع كن از مغز و از بينی زكام
target: Cleanse thou the rheum from out thine head

source: تا كه ريح اللّه در آيد در مشام
target: And breathe the breath of God instead.

source: باری اختلاف محلّ واضح و مبرهن شد
target: In sum, the differences in objects have now been made plain

source: امّا نظر سالك وقتی در محلّ محدود است يعنی در زجاجات سير مينمايد اينست كه زرد و سرخ و سفيد بيند
target: Thus when the wayfarer gazeth only upon the place of appearance - that is, when he seeth only the many-colored globes - he beholdeth yellow and red and white

source: باين جهت است كه جدال بين عباد برپا شده
target: hence it is that conflict hath prevailed among the creatures

source: عالم را غبار تيره از انفس محدوده فرا گرفته
target: a darksome dust from limited souls hath hid the world

source: بعضی نظر باشراق ضوء دارند و برخی از خمر وحدت نوشيده‌اند
target: some do gaze upon the effulgence of the light; and some have drunk of the wine of oneness
these see nothing but the sun itself

source: پس بسبب سير اين سه مقام مختلف فهم سالكين و بيان ايشان مختلف ميشود
target: Thus, for that they move on these three differing planes, the understanding and the words of the wayfarers have differed

source: اين است كه اثر اختلاف در عالم ظاهر شده و ميشود
target: hence the sign of conflict doth continually appear on earth

source: زيرا كه بعضی در رتبهٴ توحيد واقفند و از آن عالم سخن گويند
target: For some there are who dwell upon the plane of oneness and speak of that world
some inhabit the realms of limitation

source: بعضی در مراتب نفس و برخی بالمرّه محتجبند
target: some the grades of self, while others are completely veiled

source: اينست كه جهّال عصر كه از پرتو جمال نصيب نبرده‌اند ببعضی مقال تكلّم مينمايند
target: Thus do the ignorant people of the day, who have no portion of the radiance of Divine Beauty, make certain claims

source: در هر عصر و زمان بر اهل لجّهٴ توحيد وارد مياورند آنچه را كه خود بان لايق و سزاوارند
target: in every age and cycle inflict on the people of the sea of oneness what they themselves deserve

source: "و لو يؤاخذ اللّه النّاس بما كسبوا ما ترك علی ظَهرها من دابّةٍ و لكن يؤخّرهم الی اجل مسمّی "
target: "Should God punish men for their perverse doings, He would not leave on earth a moving thing! But to an appointed term doth He respite them...."

source: ای برادر من قلب لطيف بمنزلهٴ آئينه است آن را بصيقل حبّ و انقطاع از ما سوی اللّه پاك كن
target: O My Brother! A pure heart is as a mirror; cleanse it with the burnish of love and severance from all save God

source: تا آفتاب حقيقی در آن جلوه نمايد و صبح ازلی طالع شود
target: that the true sun may shine within it and the eternal morning dawn

source: معنی " لا يسعنی ارضی و لا سمائی و لكن يسعنی قلب عبدی المؤمن " را آشكار و هويدا بينی
target: Then wilt thou clearly see the meaning of "Neither doth My earth nor My heaven contain Me, but the heart of My faithful servant containeth Me."

source: جان در دست گيری و بهزار حسرت نثار يار تازه نمائی
target: thou wilt take up thy life in thine hand, and with infinite longing cast it before the new Beloved One

source: چون انوار تجلّی سلطان احديّه بر عرش قلب و دل جلوس نمود نور او در جميع اعضاء و اركان ظاهر ميشود
target: Whensoever the light of Manifestation of the King of Oneness settleth upon the throne of the heart and soul, His shining becometh visible in every limb and member

source: آن وقت سرّ حديث مشهور سر از حجاب ديجور بر آرد " لازال العبد يتقرّب الیّ بالنّوافل حتّی احببته فاذا احببته كنتُ سمعه الّذی يسمع به " الخ
target: At that time the mystery of the famed tradition gleameth out of the darkness: "A servant is drawn unto Me in prayer until I answer him; and when I have answered him, I become the ear wherewith he heareth...."

source: زيرا كه صاحب بيت در بيت خود تجلّی نموده
target: For thus the Master of the house hath appeared within His home

source: اركان بيت همه از نور او روشن و منوّر شده
target: all the pillars of the dwelling are ashine with His light.

source: وفعل و اثر نور از منير است
target: And the action and effect of the light are from the Light-Giver;

source: اينست كه همه باو حركت نمايند و باراده او قيام كنند
target: so it is that all move through Him and arise by His will.

source: اينست آن چشمهٴ كه مقربين از آن می نوشند
target: And this is that spring whereof the near ones drink

source: چنانچه ميفرمايد " عينا يشرب بها المقرّبون "
target: as it is said: "A fount whereof the near unto God shall drink...."

source: ديگر آنكه مباد در اين بيانات رايحهٴ حلول و يا تنزّلات عوالم حق در مراتب خلق رود
target: However, let none construe these utterances to be anthropomorphism, nor see in them the descent of the worlds of God into the grades of the creatures
nor should they lead thine Eminence to such assumptions

source: زيرا كه بذاته مقدس است از صعود و نزول و از دخول و خروج
target: For God is, in His Essence, holy above ascent and descent, entrance and exit;

source: لم يزل از صفات خلق غنی بوده و خواهد بود
target: He hath through all eternity been free of the attributes of human creatures, and ever will remain so

source: نشناخته او را احدی و بكنه او راه نيافته نفسی
target: No man hath ever known Him; no soul hath ever found the pathway to His Being.

source: كلّ عرفا در وادی معرفتش سرگردان
target: Every mystic knower hath wandered far astray in the valley of the knowledge of Him

source: كلّ اوليا در ادراك ذاتش حيران
target: every saint hath lost his way in seeking to comprehend His Essence.

source: منزّه است از ادراك هر مدركی
target: Sanctified is He above the understanding of the wise;

source: متعالی است از عرفان هر عارفی
target: exalted is He above the knowledge of the knowing

source: السّبيل مسدود و الطّلب مردود دليله آياته و وجوده اثباته
target: The way is barred and to seek it is impiety; His proof is His signs; His being is His evidence

source: اينست كه عاشقان روی جانان گفته‌اند " يا من دلّ علی ذاته بذاته و تنزّه عن مجانسة مخلوقاته "
target: Wherefore, the lovers of the face of the Beloved have said: "O Thou, the One Whose Essence alone showeth the way to His Essence, and Who is sanctified above any likeness to His creatures."

source: عدم صرف كجا تواند در ميدان قِدم اسب دواند
target: How can utter nothingness gallop its steed in the field of preexistence

source: سايهٴ فانی كجا بخورشيد باقی رسد
target: or a fleeting shadow reach to the everlasting sun?
The Friend hath said, "But for Thee, we had not known Thee

source: محبوب " او ادنی ما بلغناك " گفته
target: the Beloved hath said, "nor attained Thy presence."

source: بلی اين ذكرها كه در مراتب عرفان ذكر ميشود معرفت تجلّيات آن شمس حقيقت است كه در مرايا تجلّی ميفرمايد
target: Yea, these mentionings that have been made of the grades of knowledge relate to the knowledge of the Manifestations of that Sun of Reality, which casteth Its light upon the Mirrors

source: تجلّی آن نور در قلوب هست و لكن بحجبات نفسانيّه و شؤنات عرضيّه محجوبست چون شمع زير فانوس حديد
target: And the splendor of that light is in the hearts, yet it is hidden under the veilings of sense and the conditions of this earth, even as a candle within a lantern of iron

source: چون فانوس مرتفع شد نور شمع ظاهر گردد
target: and only when the lantern is removed doth the light of the candle shine out.

source: همچنين چون خرق حجبات افكيّه از وجه قلب نمائی انوار احديّه طالع شود
target: In like manner, when thou strippest the wrappings of illusion from off thine heart, the lights of oneness will be made manifest

source: پس معلوم شد كه ازبرای تجلّيات هم دخول و خروج نيست تا چه رسد بان جوهر وجود و سرّ مقصود
target: Then it is clear that even for the rays there is neither entrance nor exit - how much less for that Essence of Being and that longed-for Mystery

source: ای برادر من در اين مراتب از روی تحقيق سير نما نه از روی تقليد
target: O My Brother, journey upon these planes in the spirit of search, not in blind imitation

source: سالك را دور باش كلمات منع نكند و هيمنه اشارت سدّ ننمايد
target: A true wayfarer will not be kept back by the bludgeon of words nor debarred by the warning of allusions

source: پرده چه باشد ميان عاشق و معشوق
target: How shall a curtain part the lover and the loved one?

source: سدّ سكندر نه مانع است و نه حائل
target: Not Alexander's wall can separate them
Secrets are many, but strangers are myriad

source: سرّ محبوب را دفترها كفايت نكند و باين الواح اتمام نيابد با اينكه حرفی بيش نيست و رمزی بيش نه
target: Volumes will not suffice to hold the mystery of the Beloved One, nor can it be exhausted in these pages, although it be no more than a word, no more than a sign.
"Knowledge is a single point, but the ignorant have multiplied it."

source: از همين مقام اختلافات عوالم را هم ملاحظه كن
target: On this same basis, ponder likewise the differences among the worlds.

source: اگر چه عوالم الهی نا متناهی است و لكن بعضی چهار رتبه ذكر نموده‌اند
target: Although the divine worlds be never ending, yet some refer to them as four

source: عالم زمان و آن آنست كه از برای او اوّل و آخر باشد
target: The world of time (zaman), which is the one that hath both a beginning and an end

source: عالم دهر يعنی اوّل داشته باشد و آخرش پديد نباشد
target: the world of duration (dahr), which hath a beginning, but whose end is not revealed

source: عالم سرمد كه اوّلی ملاحظه نشود و آخرش مفهوم شود
target: the world of perpetuity (sarmad), whose beginning is not to be seen but which is known to have an end

source: عالم ازل كه نه اوّلی مشاهده شود و نه آخری
target: and the world of eternity (azal), neither a beginning nor an end of which is visible

source: اگر چه در اين بيانات اختلاف بسيار است اگر تفصيل ذكر شود كسالت افزايد
target: Although there are many differing statements as to these points, to recount them in detail would result in weariness.

source: چنانچه بعضی عالم سرمد را بی ابتدا و انتها گفته‌اند و عالم ازل را غيب منيع لا يدرك ذكر نموده‌اند
target: Thus, some have said that the world of perpetuity hath neither beginning nor end, and have named the world of eternity as the invisible, impregnable Empyrean.

source: بعضی عوالم لاهوت و جبروت و ملكوت و ناسوت گفته‌اند
target: Others have called these the worlds of the Heavenly Court (Lahut), of the Empyrean Heaven (Jabarut), of the Kingdom of the Angels (Malakut), and of the mortal world (Nasut).

source: سفرهای سبيل عشق را چهار شمرده اند
target: The journeys in the pathway of love are reckoned as four

source: من الخلق الی الحقّ و من الحقّ الی الخلق و من الخلق الی الخلق و من الحقّ الی الحقّ
target: From the creatures to the True One; from the True One to the creatures; from the creatures to the creatures; from the True One to the True One

source: بسيار بيانات از عرفا و حكمای قبل هست كه بنده متعرّض نشدم
target: There is many an utterance of the mystic seers and doctors of former times which I have not mentioned here

source: دوست ندارم كه اذكار قبل بسيار اظهار شود
target: since I mislike the copious citation from sayings of the past;

source: زيرا كه اقوال غير را ذكر نمودن دليل است بر علوم كسبی نه بر موهبت الهی
target: for quotation from the words of others proveth acquired learning, not the divine bestowal.

source: و لكن اينقدر هم كه ذكر شد بواسطه عادت ناس است و تأسّی باصحاب
target: Even so much as We have quoted here is out of deference to the wont of men and after the manner of the friends.

source: علاوه بر اين درين رساله اين بيانات نگنجد
target: Further, such matters are beyond the scope of this epistle

source: عدم اقبال بذكر اقوال ايشان نه از غرور است بل بواسطهٴ ظهور حكمت و تجلّی موهبت است
target: Our unwillingness to recount their sayings is not from pride, rather is it a manifestation of wisdom and a demonstration of grace

source: گر خضر در بحر كشتی را شكست صد درستی در شكست خضر هست
target: If Khidr did wreck the vessel on the sea, Yet in this wrong there are a thousand rights.

source: و الّا اين بنده خود را در ساحت يكی از احبای خدا معدوم ميدانم و مفقود می شمرم تا چه رسد در بساط اوليا
target: Otherwise, this Servant regardeth Himself as utterly lost and as nothing, even beside one of the beloved of God, how much less in the presence of His holy ones
Exalted be My Lord, the Supreme

source: از اينها گذشته مقصود ذكر مراتب سالكين است نه بيان اقوال عارفين
target: Moreover, our aim is to recount the stages of the wayfarer's journey, not to set forth the conflicting utterances of the mystics.

source: اگر چه مثال مختصری در اول و آخر عالم نسبی و اضافی زده شد مجدّد مثالی ديگر ذكر ميشود تا تمام معانی در قميص مثالی ظاهر شود
target: Although a brief example hath been given concerning the beginning and ending of the relative world, the world of attributes, yet a second illustration is now added, that the full meaning may be manifest

source: مثلاً آنجناب در خود ملاحظه فرمايند كه نسبت به پسر خود اوّلند و نسبت بپدر خود آخر
target: For instance, let thine Eminence consider his own self; thou art first in relation to thy son, last in relation to thy father

source: در ظاهر حكايت از ظاهر قدرت ميكنيد در عوالم صنع الهی و در باطن بر اسرار باطن كه وديعه الهيّه است در شما
target: In thine outward appearance, thou tellest of the appearance of power in the realms of divine creation; in thine inward being thou revealest the hidden mysteries which are the divine trust deposited within thee.

source: پس صدق اوليّت و آخريت و ظاهريّت و باطنيّت باين معنی كه ذكر شد بر شما می كند
target: And thus firstness and lastness, outwardness and inwardness are, in the sense referred to, true of thyself

source: تا در اين چهار رتبه كه بشما عنايت شد چهار رتبهٴ الهيّه را ادراك فرمائيد
target: that in these four states conferred upon thee thou shouldst comprehend the four divine states

source: تا بلبل قلب بر جميع شاخسارهای گل وجود از غيب و شهود ندا كند بانّه هو الاوّل و الاخر و الظّاهر و الباطن
target: and that the nightingale of thine heart on all the branches of the rosetree of existence, whether visible or concealed, should cry out: "He is the first and the last, the Seen and the Hidden...."

source: اين ذكرها در مراتب عوالم نسبت ذكر ميشود
target: These statements are made in the sphere of that which is relative, because of the limitations of men

source: و الّا آن رجالی كه بقدمی عالم نسبت و تقييد را طی نموده‌اند و بر بساط خوش تجريد ساكن شده‌اند و در عالمهای اطلاق و امر خيمه بر افراخته‌اند جميع اين نسبتها را بناری سوخته‌اند
target: Otherwise, those personages who in a single step have passed over the world of the relative and the limited, and dwelt on the fair plane of the Absolute, and pitched their tent in the worlds of authority and command - have burned away these relativities with a single spark,

source: همهٴ اين الفاظ را بنمی محو نموده‌اند
target: blotted out these words with a drop of dew
And they swim in the sea of the spirit

source: در هوای قدس نور سير ميكنند
target: soar in the holy air of light

source: ديگر الفاظ در اين رتبه كجا وجود دارد تا اوّل يا آخر يا غير اينها معلوم شود و مذكور آيد
target: Then what life have words, on such a plane, that "first" and "last" or other than these be seen or mentioned

source: در اين مقام اوّل نفس آخر و آخر نفسِ اوّل است
target: In this realm, the first is the last itself, and the last is but the first

source: آتشی از عشق جانان بر فروز
target: In thy soul of love build thou a fire

source: سر بسر فكر و عبادت را بسوز
target: And burn all thoughts and words entire

source: ايدوست من در خود ملاحظه فرما كه اگر پدر نميشدی و پسر نديده بودی اين الفاظ هم نشنيده بودی
target: O my friend, look upon thyself: Hadst thou not become a father nor begotten a son, neither wouldst thou have heard these sayings.

source: پس حال همه را فراموش كن تا در مصطبهٴ توحيد نزد اديب عشق بياموزی
target: Now forget them all, that thou mayest learn from the Master of Love in the schoolhouse of oneness

source: از " انّا " به " راجعون " رجعت كنی
از باطن مجازی بمقام حقيقی خود واصل گردی
target: and forsake the inner land of unreality for thy true station

source: در ظل شجرهٴ دانش ساكن شوی
target: dwell within the shadow of the tree of knowledge

source: ای عزيز نفس را فقير نما تا در عرصه بلند غنا وارد شوی
target: O thou dear one! Impoverish thyself, that thou mayest enter the high court of riches

source: جسد را ذليل كن تا از شريعهٴ عزت بياشامی
target: humble thy body, that thou mayest drink from the river of glory

source: بجميع معانی اشعار كه سؤال فرمودی برسی
target: attain to the full meaning of the poems whereof thou hadst asked.

source: پس معلوم شد كه اين مراتب بسته بسير سالك است
target: Thus it hath been made clear that these stages depend on the vision of the wayfarer.

source: در هر مدينه عالمی بيند و در هر وادی بچشمهٴ رسد و در هر صحرا نغمهٴ شنود
target: In every city he will behold a world, in every Valley reach a spring, in every meadow hear a song.

source: ولی شاهباز هوای معنوی را شهنازهای بديع روحانی در دل است
target: But the falcon of the mystic heaven hath many a wondrous carol of the spirit in His breast

source: و مرغ عراقی را آوازهای خوش حجازی در سر
target: and the Persian bird keepeth in His soul many a sweet Arab melody

source: و لكن مستور بوده و مستور خواهد بود
target: yet these are hidden, and hidden shall remain

source: گر بگويم عقلها بر هم زند
target: If I speak forth, many a mind will shatter
And if I write, many a pen will break

source: و السّلام علی من قطع هذا السّفر الاعلی و اتّبع الحقّ بانوار الهدی
target: Peace be upon him who concludeth this exalted journey and followeth the True One by the lights of guidance

source: و سالك بعد از قطع معارج اين سفر بلند اعلی در مدينه استغنا وارد ميشود
target: And the wayfarer, after traversing the high planes of this supernal journey, entereth THE VALLEY OF CONTENTMENT

source: و در اين وادی نسايم استغنای الهی را بيند كه از بيدای روح می وزد
target: In this Valley he feeleth the winds of divine contentment blowing from the plane of the spirit
He burneth away the veils of want

source: از حزن بسرور آيد و از غم بفرح راجع شود
target: From sorrow he turneth to bliss, from anguish to joy

source: قبض و انقباض را به بسط و انبساط تبديل نمايد
target: His grief and mourning yield to delight and rapture

source: مسافران اين وادی اگر در ظاهر بر خاك ساكنند امّا در باطن بر رفرف معانی جالس
target: Although to outward view, the wayfarers in this Valley may dwell upon the dust, yet inwardly they are throned in the heights of mystic meaning

source: از نعمتهای بی زوال معنوی مرزوقند و از شرابهای لطيف روحانی مشروب
target: they eat of the endless bounties of inner significances, and drink of the delicate wines of the spirit.

source: زبان در تفصيل اين سه وادی عاجز است و بيان بغايت قاصر
target: The tongue faileth in describing these three Valleys, and speech falleth short.

source: قلم در اين عرصه قدم نگذارد و مداد جز سواد ثمر نيارد
target: The pen steppeth not into this region, the ink leaveth only a blot

source: بلبل قلب را در اين مقامات نواهای ديگر است و اسرار ديگر كه دل از او بجوش و روح در خروش
target: In these planes, the nightingale of the heart hath other songs and secrets, which make the heart to stir and the soul to clamor,

source: و لكن اين معمای معانی را دل بدل بايد گفت و سينه بسينه بايد سپرد
target: but this mystery of inner meaning may be whispered only from heart to heart, confided only from breast to breast

source: شرح حال عارفان دل بدل تواند گفت
target: Only heart to heart can speak the bliss of mystic knowers

source: اين نه شيوهٴ قاصد و اين نه حدّ مكتوبست
target: No messenger can tell it and no missive bear it.
I am silent from weakness on many a matter,

source: بنطقی لن تحصی و لو قلت قلّت
target: For my words could not reckon them and my speech would fall short

source: ای رفيق تا بحديقهٴ اين معانی نرسی از خمر باقی اين وادی نچشی
target: O friend, till thou enter the garden of such mysteries, thou shalt never set lip to the undying wine of this Valley

source: و اگر چشی از غير چشم پوشی
target: And shouldst thou taste of it, thou wilt shield thine eyes from all things else
and drink of the wine of contentment

source: و از همه بگسلی و باو پيوندی
target: and thou wilt loose thyself from all things else

source: و جان در رهش بازی و روان رايگان بر افشانی
target: and bind thyself to Him, and throw thy life down in His path, and cast thy soul away

source: اگر چه غيری در اين مقام نيست تا چشم پوشی " كان اللّه و لم يكن معه من شئ "
target: However, there is no other in this region that thou need forget: "There was God and there was naught beside Him."

source: زيرا كه سالك در اين رتبه جمال دوست را در هر شئ بيند
target: For on this plane the traveler witnesseth the beauty of the Friend in everything
Even in fire, he seeth the face of the Beloved.

source: و در مجاز رمز حقيقت ملاحظه كند و از صفات سرّ هويت مشاهده نمايد
target: He beholdeth in illusion the secret of reality, and readeth from the attributes the riddle of the Essence.

source: زيرا پرده ها را باهی سوخته و حجابها را بنگاهی برداشته
target: For he hath burnt away the veils with his sighing, and unwrapped the shroudings with a single glance

source: ببصر حديد در صنع جديد سير نمايد
target: with piercing sight he gazeth on the new creation

source: و بقلب رقيق آثار دقيق ادراك كند
target: with lucid heart he graspeth subtle verities

source: و جعلنا اليوم بصرك حديداً شاهد مقال و كافی احوال است
target: This is sufficiently attested by: "And we have made thy sight sharp in this day."

source: سالك بعد از سير مراتب استغنای بحت در وادی حيرت واصل ميشود و در بحرهای عظمت غوطه ميخورد
target: After journeying through the planes of pure contentment, the traveler cometh to THE VALLEY OF WONDERMENT and is tossed in the oceans of grandeur

source: و در هر آن بر حيرتش می افزايد
target: at every moment his wonder groweth

source: گاهی هيكل غنا را نفس فقر می بيند و جوهر استغنا را صرف عجز
target: Now he seeth the shape of wealth as poverty itself, and the essence of freedom as sheer impotence
Now is he struck dumb with the beauty of the All-Glorious

source: و گاهی از وجود خود بيزار
target: again is he wearied out with his own life

source: اين صرصر حيرت چه درختهای معانی را كه از پا انداخت و چه نفوسها را كه از نفس بر انداخت
target: How many a mystic tree hath this whirlwind of wonderment snatched by the roots, how many a soul hath it exhausted.

source: زيرا كه اين وادی سالك را در انقلاب آورد
target: For in this Valley the traveler is flung into confusion

source: و ليكن اين ظهورات در نظر واصل بسيار محبوب و مرغوب است
target: albeit, in the eye of him who hath attained, such marvels are esteemed and well beloved

source: و در هر آن عالم بديعی و خلق جديدی مشاهده كند
target: At every moment he beholdeth a wondrous world, a new creation
and goeth from astonishment to astonishment,

source: محو صنع جديد سلطان احديّه شود
target: and is lost in awe at the works of the Lord of Oneness.

source: بلی ای برادر اگر در هر خلقی تفكرّ نمائيم صد هزار حكمت بالغه بينيم و صد هزار علوم بديعه بياموزيم
target: Indeed, O Brother, if we ponder each created thing, we shall witness a myriad perfect wisdoms and learn a myriad new and wondrous truths.
One of the created phenomena is the dream.

source: ملاحظه كن چقدر اسرار در او وديعه گذاشته شده است
target: Behold how many secrets are deposited therein,

source: چه حكمتها در او مخزون گشته است
و چه عوالم در او مستور مانده
ملاحظه فرمائيد كه شما در بيتی ميخوابيد و درهای آن بيت بسته است يكمرتبه خود را در شهر بعيدی مشاهده ميكنيد
target: Observe, how thou art asleep in a dwelling, and its doors are barred; on a sudden thou findest thyself in a far-off city

source: بی حركت رجل و تعب جسد بان شهر داخل ميشويد
target: which thou enterest without moving thy feet or wearying thy body

source: و بی زحمت چشم مشاهده می كنيد و بی محنت گوش می شنويد و بی لسان تكلّم مينمائيد
target: without using thine eyes, thou seest; without taxing thine ears, thou hearest; without a tongue, thou speakest.

source: گاهست كه آنچه امشب ديده ايد ده سال بعد در عالم زمان بحسب ظاهر بعينه آنچه در خواب ديده‌ايد می بينيد
target: And perchance when ten years are gone, thou wilt witness in the outer world the very things thou hast dreamed tonight.

source: حال چند حكمت است كه در اين نوم مشهود است و غير اهل اين وادی بر كما هی ادراك نمی كنند
target: Now there are many wisdoms to ponder in the dream, which none but the people of this Valley can comprehend in their true elements

source: اوّل آنكه آن چه عالم است كه بی چشم و گوش و دست و لسان حكم همهٴ اينها در او معمول ميشود
target: First, what is this world, where without eye and ear and hand and tongue a man puts all of these to use?

source: و ثانی آنكه در عالم ظهور اثر خواب را امروز مشاهده ميكنی و ليكن اين سير را در عالم نوم در ده سال قبل ديدهٴ
target: Second, how is it that in the outer world thou seest today the effect of a dream, when thou didst vision it in the world of sleep some ten years past?

source: حال تفكّر نما فرق اين دو عالم و اسرار مودعه آن را تا بتأييدات و مكاشفات سبحانی فائز شوی و پی بعالم قدس بری
target: Consider the difference between these two worlds and the mysteries which they conceal, that thou mayest attain to divine confirmations and heavenly discoveries and enter the regions of holiness.

source: اين آيات را حضرت باری در خلق گذاشته تا محقّقين انكار اسرار معاد نكنند و بانچه وعده داده شده اند سهل نشمرند
target: God, the Exalted, hath placed these signs in men, to the end that philosophers may not deny the mysteries of the life beyond nor belittle that which hath been promised them.

source: مثل اينكه بعضی تمسك بعقل جسته و آنچه بعقل نيايد انكار نمايند
target: For some hold to reason and deny whatever the reason comprehendeth not

source: و حال آنكه هر گز عقول ضعيفه همين مراتب مذكوره را ادراك نكند مگر عقل كلّی ربّانی
target: and yet weak minds can never grasp the matters which we have related, but only the Supreme, Divine Intelligence can comprehend them

source: عقل جزئی كی تواند گشت بر قرآن محيط
target: How can feeble reason encompass the Qur'an,

source: عنكبوتی كی تواند كرد سيمرغی شكار
target: Or the spider snare a phoenix in his web?

source: و اين عوالم كلّ در وادی حيرت دست دهد و مشاهده گردد
target: All these states are to be witnessed in the Valley of Wonderment,

source: و سالك در هر آن زيادتی طلب نمايد و كسل نشود
target: and the traveler at every moment seeketh for more, and is not wearied

source: اين است كه سيّد اوّلين و آخرين در مراتب فكرت و اظهار حيرت " ربّ زدنی فيك تحيّرا " فرموده
target: Thus the Lord of the First and the Last in setting forth the grades of contemplation, and expressing wonderment hath said: "O Lord, increase my astonishment at Thee!"

source: و همچنين تفكر در تماميّت خلق انسان كن كه اين همه عوالم و اين همه مراتب در او منطوی و مستور شده
target: Likewise, reflect upon the perfection of man's creation, and that all these planes and states are folded up and hidden away within him.

source: اتحسب انّك جرمُ صَغير و فيك انطوی العالم الاكبر
target: Dost thou reckon thyself only a puny form When within thee the universe is folded?

source: پس جهدی بايد كه رتبهٴ حيوانی معدوم كنيم تا معنی انسانی ظاهر شود
target: Then we must labor to destroy the animal condition, till the meaning of humanity shall come to light.

source: همچنين لقمان كه از چشمه حكمت نوشيده و از بحر رحمت چشيده بپسرش ناتان بجهت اثبات مقامات حشر و موت همين خواب را دليل آورده و مثل زده
target: Thus, too, Luqman, who had drunk from the wellspring of wisdom and tasted of the waters of mercy, in proving to his son Nathan the planes of resurrection and death, advanced the dream as an evidence and an example.

source: درين مقام ذكر مينمائيم تا ذكری از آن جوان مصطبهٴ توحيد و پير مراتب تعليم و تجريد از ين بنده فانی باقی بماند
target: We relate it here, that through this evanescent Servant a memory may endure of that youth of the school of Divine Unity, that elder of the art of instruction and the Absolute.

source: فرمود ای پسر اگر قادر باشی كه نخوابی پس قادری بر آنكه نميری
target: He said: "O Son, if thou art able not to sleep, then thou art able not to die

source: و اگر بتوانی بعد از خواب بيدار نشوی ميتوانی كه بعد از مرگ محشور نگردی
target: And if thou art able not to waken after sleep, then thou shalt be able not to rise after death."

source: ای دوست دل كه محلّ اسرار باقيه است محل افكار فانيه مكن
target: O friend, the heart is the dwelling of eternal mysteries, make it not the home of fleeting fancies

source: و سرمايه عمر گرانمايه را باشتغال دنيای فانيه از دست مده
target: waste not the treasure of thy precious life in employment with this swiftly passing world.

source: از عالم قدسی بتراب دل مبند
target: Thou comest from the world of holiness - bind not thine heart to the earth

source: و اهل بساط انسی وطن خاكی مپسند
target: thou art a dweller in the court of nearness - choose not the homeland of the dust.

source: باری ذكر اين مراتب را انتهائی نه و اين بنده را از صدمهٴ اهل روزگار احوالی نه
target: In sum, there is no end to the description of these stages, but because of the wrongs inflicted by the peoples of the earth, this Servant is in no mood to continue:

source: اين سخن ناقص بماند و بيقرار دل ندارم بيدلم معذور دار
target: The tale is still unfinished and I have no heart for it - Then pray forgive me.

source: قلم ناله ميكند و مداد ميگريد و جيحون دل خون موج ميزند
target: The pen groaneth and the ink sheddeth tears, and the river of the heart moveth in waves of blood.

source: " لن يصيبنا الّا ما كتب اللّه لنا "
target: "Nothing can befall us but what God hath destined for us."

source: و السّلام علی من اتّبع الهدی
target: Peace be upon him who followeth the Right Path!

source: و سالك بعد از ارتقای بمراتب بلند حيرت بوادی فقر حقيقی و فنای اصلی وارد شود
target: After scaling the high summits of wonderment the wayfarer cometh to THE VALLEY OF TRUE POVERTY AND ABSOLUTE NOTHINGNESS

source: اين رتبه مقام فنای از نفس و بقای باللّه است و فقر از خود و غنای بمقصود است
target: This station is the dying from self and the living in God, the being poor in self and rich in the Desired One

source: در اين مقام كه ذكر فقر ميشود يعنی فقير است از آنچه در عالم خلق است و غنی است بانچه در عوالم حق است
target: Poverty as here referred to signifieth being poor in the things of the created world, rich in the things of God's world

source: زيرا كه عاشق صادق و حبيب موافق چون بلقای محبوب و معشوق رسيد از پرتو جمال محبوب و آتش قلب حبيب ناری مشتعل شود و جميع سرادقات و حجباترا بسوزاند
target: For when the true lover and devoted friend reacheth to the presence of the Beloved, the sparkling beauty of the Loved One and the fire of the lover's heart will kindle a blaze and burn away all veils and wrappings.

source: بلكه آنچه با اوست حتی مغز و پوست محترق گردد و جز دوست چيزی نماند
target: Yea, all he hath, from heart to skin, will be set aflame, so that nothing will remain save the Friend.

source: چون تجلی كرد اوصاف قديم پس بسوزد وصف حادث را كليم
target: When the qualities of the Ancient of Days stood revealed, Then the qualities of earthly things did Moses burn away.

source: در اين مقام واصل مقدس است از آنچه متعلق بدنياست
target: He who hath attained this station is sanctified from all that pertaineth to the world

source: پس اگر در نزد واصلين بحر وصال از اشياء محدوده كه متعلق بعالم فانی است يافت نشود چه از اموال ظاهريّه باشد و چه از تفكّرات نفسيّه بأسی نيست
target: Wherefore, if those who have come to the sea of His presence are found to possess none of the limited things of this perishable world, whether it be outer wealth or personal opinions, it mattereth not.

source: زيرا كه آنچه نزد خلق است محدود است بحدود ايشان و آنچه نزد حق است مقدّس از آن
target: For whatever the creatures have is limited by their own limits, and whatever the True One hath is sanctified therefrom

source: اين بيان را بسيار فكر بايد تا پايان آشكار شود
target: this utterance must be deeply pondered that its purport may be clear

source: " انّ الابرار يشربون من كأس كان مزاجها كافورا "
target: "Verily the righteous shall drink of a winecup tempered at the camphor fountain."

source: اگر معنی كافور معلوم شود مقصود حقيقی معلوم گردد
target: If the interpretation of "camphor" become known, the true intention will be evident.

source: اين مقام از فقرست كه ميفرمايد " الفقر فخری "
target: This state is that poverty of which it is said, "Poverty is My glory."

source: از برای فقر باطنی و ظاهری مراتبها و معنيهاست كه ذكر آنرا مناسب اين مقام نديدم لهذا بعهدهٴ وقتی گذاشتم تا خدا چه خواهد و قضا چه امضا نمايد
target: of inward and outward poverty there is many a stage and many a meaning which I have not thought pertinent to mention here; hence I have reserved these for another time, dependent on what God may desire and fate may seal

source: و اين مقام است كه كثرات كلّ شئ در سالك هالك شود
target: This is the plane whereon the vestiges of all things (Kullu Shay') are destroyed in the traveler

source: و طلعت وجه از مشرق بقا سر از غطا بيرون آورد
target: and on the horizon of eternity the Divine Face riseth out of the darkness

source: و معنی " كلّ شئ هالك الّا وجهه " مشهود گردد
target: and the meaning of "All on the earth shall pass away, but the face of thy Lord...." is made manifest.

source: ای حبيب من نغمات روح را بجان و دل گوش كن و چون بصر حفظش نما
target: O My friend, listen with heart and soul to the songs of the spirit, and treasure them as thine own eyes.

source: كه هميشه ايّام معارف الهی بمثابه ابر نيسانی بر اراضی قلوب انسانی جاری نيست
target: For the heavenly wisdoms, like the clouds of spring, will not rain down on the earth of men's hearts forever;

source: اگر چه فيض فيّاض را تعطيلی و تعويقی نه و لكن هر زمان و عصر را رزقی معلوم و نعمتی مقدرست
target: and though the grace of the All-Bounteous One is never stilled and never ceasing, yet to each time and era a portion is allotted and a bounty set apart,

source: و بقدر و اندازه افاضه ميشود
" و ان من شئ الّا عندنا خزآئنه و ما ننزّله الّا بقدر معلوم "
target: "And no one thing is there, but with Us are its storehouses; and We send it not down but in settled measure."

source: سحاب رحمت جانان جز بر رياض جان نبارد
target: The cloud of the Loved One's mercy raineth only on the garden of the spirit,

source: و در غير بهاران اين كرم نفرمايد
target: and bestoweth this bounty only in the season of spring

source: فصول ديگر را ازين فضل اكبر نصيبی نيست
target: The other seasons have no share in this greatest grace,

source: و اراضی جرزه را ازين كرم قسمتی نه
target: and barren lands no portion of this favor.

source: ای برادر هر بحری لؤلؤ ندارد
target: O Brother! Not every sea hath pearls
nor will the nightingale sing thereon

source: پس تا بلبل بوستان معنوی بگلستان الهی باز نگشت و انوار صبح معانی بشمس حقيقی راجع نشد سعی كنيد كه شايد در اين گلخن فانی بوئی از گلشن باقی بشنويد
target: Then, ere the nightingale of the mystic paradise repair to the garden of God, and the rays of the heavenly morning return to the Sun of Truth - make thou an effort, that haply in this dustheap of the mortal world thou mayest catch a fragrance from the everlasting garden

source: و در ظل اهل اين مدينه جاويد بمانيد
target: and live forever in the shadow of the peoples of this city

source: و چون باين رتبهٴ بلند اعلی رسيدی و باين درجهٴ عظمی فائز شدی يار بينی و اغيار فراموش كنی
target: And when thou hast attained this highest station and come to this mightiest plane, then shalt thou gaze on the Beloved, and forget all else.

source: يار بی پرده از در و ديوار در تجلّی است يا اولی الابصار
target: The Beloved shineth on gate and wall Without a veil, O men of vision.

source: از قطرهٴ جان گذشتی و ببحر جانان واصل شدی
target: Now hast thou abandoned the drop of life and come to the sea of the Life-Bestower.
This is the goal thou didst ask for
if it be God's will, thou wilt gain it.

source: در اين مدينه حجبات نور هم خرق ميشود و زايل ميگردد
target: In this city, even the veils of light are split asunder and vanish away.

source: " لا لجماله حجابُ سوی النّور و لا لوجهه نقاب الّا الظّهور "
target: "His beauty hath no veiling save light, His face no covering save revelation."

source: ای عجب كه يار چون شمس آشكار
target: How strange that while the Beloved is visible as the sun

source: و اغيار در طلب زخارف و دينار
target: yet the heedless still hunt after tinsel and base metal

source: بلی از شدّت ظهور پنهان مانده
target: Yea, the intensity of His revelation hath covered Him

source: و از كثرت بروز مخفی گشته
target: and the fullness of His shining forth hath hidden Him.

source: حق عيان چون مهر رخشان آمده حيف كاندر شهر كوران آمده
target: Even as the sun, bright hath He shined, But alas, He hath come to the town of the blind!

source: در اين وادی سالك مراتب وحدت وجود و شهود را طی نمايد و بوحدتی كه مقدّس ازين دو مقام است واصل گردد
target: In this Valley, the wayfarer leaveth behind him the stages of the "oneness of Being and Manifestation" and reacheth a oneness that is sanctified above these two stations.

source: احوال پی باين مقال برد نه بيان و جدال
target: Ecstasy alone can encompass this theme, not utterance nor argument

source: و هر كس درين محفل منزل گزيده و يا ازين رياض نسيمی يافته ميداند چه عرض ميشود
target: and whosoever hath dwelt at this stage of the journey, or caught a breath from this garden land, knoweth whereof We speak.

source: و سالك بايد در جميع اين اسفار بقدر شعری از شريعت كه فی الحقيقه سرّ طريقت و ثمرهٴ شجرهٴ حقيقت است انحراف نورزد
target: In all these journeys the traveler must stray not the breadth of a hair from the "Law," for this is indeed the secret of the "Path" and the fruit of the Tree of "Truth"

source: و در همه مراتب بذيل اطاعت اوامر متشبّث باشد
target: and in all these stages he must cling to the robe of obedience to the commandments

source: و بحبل اعراض از مناهی متمسّك
target: and hold fast to the cord of shunning all forbidden things

source: تا از كأس شريعت مرزوق شود و بر اسرار حقيقت واقف گردد
target: that he may be nourished from the cup of the Law and informed of the mysteries of Truth.

source: و هر چه از بيانات اين بنده مفهوم نشود و تزلزلی احداث كند بايد مجدّد سؤال شود تا شبهه نماند
target: If any of the utterances of this Servant may not be comprehended, or may lead to perturbation, the same must be inquired of again, that no doubt may linger,

source: و مقصود چون طلعت محبوب از مقام محمود ظاهر گردد
target: and the meaning be clear as the Face of the Beloved One shining from the "Glorious Station."

source: و اين اسفار كه آن را در عالم زمان انتهائی پديد نيست سالك منقطع را اگر اعانت غيبی برسد و ولیّ امر مدد فرمايد اين هفت رتبه را در هفت قدم طی نمايد
target: These journeys have no visible ending in the world of time, but the severed wayfarer - if invisible confirmation descend upon him and the Guardian of the Cause assist him - may cross these seven stages in seven steps

source: بلكه در هفت نفس بلكه در يكنَفس اذا شاء اللّه و اراد
target: nay rather in seven breaths, nay rather in a single breath, if God will and desire it.

source: و ذلك من فضله علی من يشاء
target: And this is of "His grace on such of His servants as He pleaseth."

source: طايران هوای توحيد و واصلان لجّه تجريد اين مقام را كه مقام بقاء باللّه است درين مدينه منتهی رتبه عارفان و منتهی وطن عاشقان شمرده اند
target: They who soar in the heaven of singleness and reach to the sea of the Absolute, reckon this city - which is the station of life in God - as the furthermost state of mystic knowers, and the farthest homeland of the lovers.

source: و نزد اين فانی بحر معنی اين مقام اوّل شهر بند دلست يعنی اوّل ورود انسان است بمدينه قلب
target: But to this evanescent One of the mystic ocean, this station is the first gate of the heart's citadel, that is, man's first entrance to the city of the heart;

source: و قلب را چهار رتبه مقرّرست اگر اهلش يافت شد مذكور آيد
target: and the heart is endowed with four stages, which would be recounted should a kindred soul be found.

source: چون قلم در وصف اينحالت رسيد هم قلم بشكست و هم كاغذ دريد و السّلام
target: When the pen set to picturing this station, It broke in pieces and the page was torn. Salam!

source: ای حبيب من اين غزال صحرای احديّه را كلابی چند در پی
target: O My friend! Many a hound pursueth this gazelle of the desert of oneness

source: و اين بلبل بستان صمديّه را منقاری چند در تعاقب
target: many a talon claweth at this thrush of the eternal garden

source: و اين طاير هوای الهی را غراب كين در كمين
target: Pitiless ravens do lie in wait for this bird of the heavens of God

source: و اين صيد برّ عشق را صيّاد حسد در عقب
target: and the huntsman of envy stalketh this deer of the meadow of love.

source: ای شيخ همت را زجاج كن كه شايد اين سراج را از بادهای مخالف حفظ نمايد
target: O Shaykh! Make of thine effort a glass, perchance it may shelter this flame from the contrary winds

source: اگر چه اين سراج را اميد چنان است كه در زجاجه الهی مشتعل گردد
target: albeit this light doth long to be kindled in the lamp of the Lord,

source: و در مشكوة معنوی بر افروزد
target: and to shine in the globe of the spirit.

source: زيرا گردنی كه بعشق الهی بلند شد البته بشمشير افتد
target: For the head raised up in the love of God will certainly fall by the sword,

source: و سری كه بحبّ بر افراخت البتّه بباد رود
target: and the life that is kindled with longing will surely be sacrificed

source: و قلبی كه بذكر محبوب پيوست البتّه پر خون گردد
target: and the heart which remembereth the Loved One will surely brim with blood

source: و عش خاليا فالحبّ راحته عنا فاوّله سقم و آخره قتل
target: Live free of love, for its very peace is anguish; Its beginning is pain, its end is death.

source: و السّلام علی من اتّبع الهدی
target: Peace be upon him who followeth the Right Path

source: آنچه از بدايع فكر در معنی طير معروف كه بفارسی گنجشك مينامند ذكر فرمودند معلوم و محقّق شد
target: The thoughts thou hast expressed as to the interpretation of the common species of bird that is called in Persian Gunjishk (sparrow) were considered.

source: گويا بر اسرار معانی واقف شده اند
target: Thou appearest to be well-grounded in mystic truth

source: و لكن هر حرفی را در هر عالمی باقتضای آن مقصودی مقرّر است
target: However, on every plane, to every letter a meaning is allotted which relateth to that plane

source: بلی سالكين از هر اسمی رمزی و از هر حرفی سرّی ادراك مينمايند
target: Indeed, the wayfarer findeth a secret in every name, a mystery in every letter.

source: و اين حروفات در مقامی اشاره بتقديس است
target: In one sense, these letters refer to holiness.

source: ك ای كفّ نفسك عمّا يشتهيه هويك ثمّ اقبل الی موليك
target: Kaf or Gaf (K or G) referreth to Kuffi ("free"), that is, "Free thyself from that which thy passion desireth; then advance unto thy Lord."

source: ن نزّه نفسك عمّا سويه لتفدی بروحك فی هويه
target: Nun referreth to Nazzih ("purify"), that is, "Purify thyself from all else save Him, that thou mayest surrender thy life in His love."

source: ج جانب جناب الحقّ ان بقی فيك من صفات الخلق
target: Jim is Janib ("draw back"), that is, "Draw back from the threshold of the True One if thou still possessest earthly attributes."

source: ش اشكر ربّك فی ارضه ليشكرك فی سمائه
target: Shin is Ushkur ("thank") - "Thank thy Lord on His earth that He may bless thee in His heaven;

source: و ان كانت السّماء فی عالم الاحديّه نفس ارضه
target: albeit in the world of oneness, this heaven is the same as His earth."

source: ك كفّر عنك الحُجبات المحدودة لتعرف ما لا عرفته من المقامات القدسيّة
target: Kaf referreth to Kuffi, that is: "Take off from thyself the wrappings of limitations, that thou mayest come to know what thou hast not known of the states of Sanctity."

source: و انّك لو تسمع نغمات هذه الطّير الفانية لتطلب من الكؤس الباقية الدّائمة و تترك الكؤب الفانية الزائلة
target: Wert thou to harken to the melodies of this mortal Bird, then wouldst thou seek out the undying chalice and pass by every perishable cup.

source: و السّلام علی من اتّبع الهدی
target: Peace be upon those who walk in the Right Path!
He is the Strong, the Well-Beloved!

source: ای ضياء الحق حسام الدين راد كه فلك و اركان چه تو شاهی نزاد
target: O light of truth, Hisam-i-Din, the bounteous, No prince hath the world begot like unto Thee!

source: نميدانم چرا يك مرتبه رشته محبت را گسيختيد
target: I am wondering why the tie of love was so abruptly severed

source: و عهد محكم مودت را شكستيد
target: and the firm covenant of friendship broken

source: مگر خدا نكرده قصوری در ارادت بهمرسيد
target: Did ever, God forbid, My devotion lessen,

source: و يا فتوری در خلوص نيّت پيدا گشت كه از نظر محو شدم و سهو آمدم
target: or My deep affection fail, that thou hast thus forgot Me and blotted Me from thy thoughts?

source: چه مخالفت بديدی كه ملاطفت بريدی
target: What fault of Mine hath made thee cease thy favors?

source: مگر آنكه ما ضعيفيم و تو احتشام داری
target: Is it that We are lowly and thou of high degree?

source: و يا بيك تير از كارزار بر گشتی
target: Or is that a single arrow hath driven thee from the battle?

source: مگر نشنيده‌ايد استقامت شرط راه است و دليل ورود بارگاه
target: Have they not told thee that faithfulness is a duty on those who follow the mystic way, that it is the true guide to His Holy Presence?

source: " انّ الّذين قالوا ربنّا اللّه ثم استقاموا تتنزّل عليهم الملئكة "
target: "But as for those who say, `Our Lord is God,' and who go straight to Him, the angels shall descend to them...."

source: و ديگر ميفرمايد " فاستقم كما امرت "
target: Likewise He saith, "Go straight on then as thou hast been commanded."

source: لهذا مستقرين بساط وصول را اين سلوك لازم و واجب است
target: Wherefore, this course is incumbent on those who dwell in the presence of God.

source: من آنچه شرط بلاغ است باتو ميگويم
target: I do as bidden, and I bring the message,

source: تو خواه از سخنم پند گير و خواه ملال
target: Whether it give thee counsel or offense.

source: اگر چه زيارت جواب نامه ننموده ذكر ارادت نزد عقلا خطا و بيجاست
target: Albeit I have received no answer to My letters and it is contrary to the usage of the wise to express My regard anew

source: و لكن محبت بديع ذ كر و قواعد قويم را منسوخ نمود و معدوم كرد
target: yet this new love hath broken all the old rules and ways.

source: قصه ليلی مخوان و غصه مجنون عشق تو منسوخ كرد ذكر اوائل
target: Tell us not the tale of Layli or of Majnun's woe - Thy love hath made the world forget the loves of long ago.

source: نام تو ميرفت عاشقان بشنيدند هر دو برقص آمدند سامع و قائل
target: When once thy name was on the tongue, the lovers caught it And it set the speakers and the hearers dancing to and fro.

source: فی حكمة الالهيّه و تنبيه الرّبانيّة
target: And of divine wisdom and heavenly counsel,

source: من سر هر ماه سه روز ای صنم بی گمان بايد كه ديوانه شوم
target: Each moon, O my beloved, for three days I go mad;

source: هان كه امروز اوّل سه روزه است روز فيروز است نه فيروزه است
target: Today's the first of these - 'Tis why thou seest me glad.

source: شنيدم برای تبحيث و تدريس بتبريز و تفليس حركت فرموده ايد
target: We hear that thou hast journeyed to Tabriz and Tiflis to disseminate knowledge

source: و يا برای عروج معارج بسنندج تشريف برده‌ايد
target: or that some other high purpose hath taken thee to Sanandaj.

source: ای سيّد من متصاعدان سموات سلوك از چهار طايفه بيش نيستند
target: O My eminent friend! Those who progress in mystic wayfaring are of four kinds

source: مختصری ذكر ميشود كه در آن خدمت معلوم و مبرهن گردد كه هر طايفه را چه علامت است و چه مرتبت
target: I shall describe them in brief, that the grades and qualities of each kind may become plain to thee.

source: اوّل اگر سالكان از طالبان كعبهٴ مقصودند
target: If the travelers seek after the goal of the Intended One (maqsud)
this station appertaineth to the self

source: و لكن نفس اللّه القائمة فيه بالسّنن مراد است
target: but that self which is "The Self of God standing within Him with laws."

source: و در اين مقام نفس محبوب است نه مردود و مقبول نه مقهور
target: On this plane, the self is not rejected but beloved; it is well-pleasing and not to be shunned.

source: اگر چه در اوّل اين رتبه محلّ جدال است و ليكن آخرآن جلوس برعرش جلال
target: Although at the beginning, this plane is the realm of conflict, yet it endeth in attainment to the throne of splendor.

source: ای خليل وقت وابراهيم هش اين چهار اطيار رهزن را بكش
target: "O Abraham of this day, O Friend Abraham of the Spirit! Kill these four birds of prey,"

source: و اين مقام نفس مرضيّه است كه ميفرمايد
target: This is the plane of the soul who is pleasing unto God. Refer to the verse:

source: " فادخلی فی عبادی و ادخلی جنّتی "
target: Enter thou among My servants, And enter thou My paradise.

source: اين مقام را اشارات بسيار است و دلالات بيشمار
target: This station hath many signs, unnumbered proofs.

source: سنريهم آياتنا فی الافاق و فی انفسهم حتّی يتبيّن لهم انّه الحقّ
target: "Hereafter We will show them Our signs in the regions of the earth, and in themselves, until it become manifest unto them that it is the truth,"
and that there is no God save Him

source: پس معلوم ميشود كه كتاب نفس را بايد مطالعه نمود نه رساله نحو را
target: One must, then, read the book of his own self, rather than some treatise on rhetoric.

source: چنانچه ميفرمايد " اقرء كتابك و كفی بنفسك اليوم حسيبا "
target: Wherefore He hath said, "Read thy Book: There needeth none but thyself to make out an account against thee this day."

source: حكايت آورده اند كه عارف الهی با عالم نحوی همراه شدند و همراز گشتند تا رسيدند بشاطی بحر العظمة
target: The story is told of a mystic knower, who went on a journey with a learned grammarian as his companion. They came to the shore of the Sea of Grandeur.

source: عارف بی تامّل توسّل فرموده و بر آب راند
target: The knower straightway flung himself into the waves

source: و عالم نحوی چون نقش بر آب محو گشته مبهوت ماند
target: but the grammarian stood lost in his reasonings, which were as words that are written on water.

source: بانگ زد عارف كه چون عنان پيچيدی
target: The knower called out to him, "Why dost thou not follow?"

source: گفت ای برادر چكنم چون پای رفتنم نيست سر نهادن اولی بود
target: The grammarian answered, "O Brother, I dare not advance. I must needs go back again."

source: گفت آنچه از سيبويه و قولويه اخذ نموده و از مطالب ابن حاجب و ابن مالك حمل فرمودهٴ بريز و از آب بگذر
target: Then the knower cried, "Forget what thou didst read in the books of Sibavayh and Qawlavayh, of Ibn-i-Hajib and Ibn-i-Malik, and cross the water."

source: محو ميبايد نه نحو اينجا بدان گر تو محوی بيخطر بر آب ران
target: The death of self is needed here, not rhetoric: Be nothing, then, and walk upon the waves.

source: " لا تكونوا كالّذين نسوا اللّه فانسا هم انفسهم اولئك هم الفاسقون "
target: "And be ye not like those who forget God, and whom He hath therefore caused to forget their own selves. These are the wicked doers."

source: و اگر سالكان از ساكنان حجره محمودند اين مقام راجع بعقل ميشود كه او را پيغمبر مينامند و ركن اعظم دانند
target: If the wayfarer's goal be the dwelling of the Praiseworthy One (Mahmud), this is the station of primal reason which is known as the Prophet and the Most Great Pillar

source: ليكن عقل كلی ربّانی مقصود است كه در اين رتبه تربيت امكان و اكوان بسلطنت اوست
target: Here reason signifieth the divine, universal mind, whose sovereignty enlighteneth all created things
nor doth it refer to every feeble brain
for it is as the wise Sana'i hath written:

source: عقل جزئی كی تواند گشت بر قرآن محيط عنكبوتی كی تواند كرد سيمرغی شكار
target: How can feeble reason encompass the Qur'an, Or the spider snare a phoenix in his web?

source: عقل اگر خواهی كه ناگه در عقيلت نفكند گوش گيرش در دبيرستان الرّحمن در آر
target: Wouldst thou that the mind should not entrap thee? Teach it the science of the love of God!

source: و در اين مقام تلاطم بسيار است و طماطم بيشمار
target: On this plane, the traveler meeteth with many a trial and reverse

source: گاهی سالك را متصاعد مينمايد و گاهی متنازل
target: Now is he lifted up to heaven, now is he cast into the depths.

source: اين است كه ميفرمايد مرة تجذبنی الی عرش العماء و مرة تهلكنی بنار الاغماء
target: As it hath been said: "Now Thou drawest me to the summit of glory, again Thou castest me into the lowest abyss."

source: چنانچه سرّ مكنونه از آيه مباركه كهف در اين مقام معلوم ميشود كه ميفرمايد " و تری الشّمس اذا طلعت تزاور عن كهفهم ذات اليمين و اذا غربت تقرضهم ذات الشمال وهم فی فجوة منه ذلك من آيات اللّه من يَهد اللّه فهو المهتد و من يضلل فلن تجد له وليّاً مرشداً
target: The mystery treasured in this plane is divulged in the following holy verse from the Surih of THE CAVE: "And thou mightest have seen the sun when it arose, pass on the right of their cave, and when it set, leave them on the left, while they were in its spacious chamber. This is one of the signs of God. Guided indeed is he whom God guideth; but for him whom He misleadeth, thou shalt by no means find a patron."

source: "اگر كسی اشارات همين يك آيه را مطّلع شود او را كافی است
target: If a man could know what lieth hid in this one verse, it would suffice him

source: اين است كه در وصف اين رجال ميفرمايد " رجال لا تلهيهم تجارة و لا بيع عن ذكر اللّه "
target: Wherefore, in praise of such as these, He hath said: "Men whom neither merchandise nor traffic beguile from the remembrance of God...."

source: اين مقام ميزان است و پايان امتحان
target: This station conferreth the true standard of knowledge, and freeth man from tests

source: و در اين رتبه هم استفاده ضرور ندارد
target: In this realm, to search after knowledge is irrelevant,

source: و در تعليم سالكين اين لجّه ميفرمايد " اتّقوا اللّه يعلّمكم اللّه "
target: for He hath said concerning the guidance of travelers on this plane, "Fear God, and God will instruct thee."

source: و همچنين ميفرمايد " العلم نور يقذفه اللّه علی قلب من يشاء "
target: And again: "Knowledge is a light which God casteth into the heart of whomsoever He willeth."

source: پس بايد محلّ را آماده نمود و مستعد نزول عنايت شد تا كه ساقی كفايت خمر مكرمت از زجاجه رحمت بنوشاند
target: Wherefore, a man should make ready his heart that it be worthy of the descent of heavenly grace, and that the bounteous Cup-Bearer may give him to drink of the wine of bestowal from the merciful vessel.
"For the like of this let the travailers travail!"

source: و حينئذٍ اقول " انّا للّه و انّا اليه راجعون "
target: And now do I say, "Verily we are from God, and to Him shall we return."

source: اگر عاشقان از عاكفان بيت مجذوبند اين سرير سلطنت را جز طلعت عشق جالس نتواند شد
target: If the loving seekers wish to live within the precincts of the Attracting One (Majdhub), no soul may dwell on this Kingly Throne save the beauty of love

source: اين مقام را شرح نتوانم و وصف ندانم
target: This realm is not to be pictured in words.

source: با دو عالم عشق را بيگانگی وندر او هفتاد و دو ديوانگی
target: Love shunneth this world and that world too, In him are lunacies seventy-and-two.

source: مطرب عشق اين زند وقت سماع بندگی بند و خداوندی صداع
target: The minstrel of love harpeth this lay: Servitude enslaveth, kingship doth betray.

source: اين رتبه صرف محبت ميطلبد و زلال مودّت ميجويد
target: This plane requireth pure affection and the bright stream of fellowship

source: و در وصف اين اصحاب ميفرمايد " الّذين لايسبقونه بالقول و هم بامره يعملون "
target: In telling of these companions of the Cave He saith: "They speak not till He hath spoken; and they do His bidding."

source: اين مقام نه سلطنت عقل را كفايت مينمايد و نه حكومت نفس را
target: On this plane, neither the reign of reason is sufficient nor the authority of self.

source: چنانچه نبيّی از انبياء اللّه عرض نمود " الهی كيف الوصول اليك
target: Hence, one of the Prophets of God hath asked: "O my Lord, how shall we reach unto Thee?"
And the answer came, "Leave thyself behind, and then approach Me."

source: ايشان قومی هستند كه صفّ نعال را با صدر جلال يك دانند
target: These are a people who deem the lowest place to be one with the throne of glory,

source: و ايوان جمال را با ميدان جدال در سبيل محبوب يك شمرند
target: and to them beauty's bower differeth not from the field of a battle fought in the cause of the Beloved.

source: معتكفين اين بيت مطلب ندانند و مركب برانند
target: The denizens of this plane speak no words - but they gallop their chargers.

source: جز نفس دوست از دوست هيچ نبينند
target: They see but the inner reality of the Beloved

source: كلّ الفاظ را مهمل دانند و جميع مهملات را مستعمل دارند
target: To them all words of sense are meaningless, and senseless words are full of meaning.

source: سر از پا نشناسند و دست از پا فرق نيابند
target: They cannot tell one limb from another, one part from another

source: سراب را نفس آب گويند و ذهاب را سرّ اياب خوانند
target: To them the mirage is the real river; to them going away is returning.

source: وصفی ز حسن روی تو در خانقه فتاد صوفی طريق خانه خمّار بر گرفت
target: The story of Thy beauty reached the hermit's dell; Crazed, he sought the Tavern where the wine they buy and sell.

source: عشقت بنای صبر بكلی خراب كرد جورت در اميد بيكبار بر گرفت
target: The love of Thee hath leveled down the fort of patience, The pain of Thee hath firmly barred the gate of hope as well.

source: در اين مقام تعليم و تعلم البته عاطل ماند و باطل گردد
target: In this realm, instruction is assuredly of no avail.

source: عاشقان را شد مدرّس حسن دوست دفتر درس و سبقشان روی اوست
target: The lover's teacher is the Loved One's beauty, His face their lesson and their only book.

source: درسشان آشوب و شور و ولوله نی زيادات است و باب سلسله
target: Learning of wonderment, of longing love their duty, Not on learned chapters and dull themes they look.

source: سلسله اين قوم جعد مشكبار مسأله دور است امّا دور يار
target: The chain that binds them is His musky hair, The Cyclic Scheme, to them, is but to Him a stair.

source: فی المناجات للّه تبارك و تعالی
target: Here followeth a supplication to God, the Exalted, the Glorified:

source: ای خدا ای لطف تو حاجت روا با تو ياد هيچكس نبود روا
target: O Lord! O Thou Whose bounty granteth wishes! I stand before Thee, all save Thee forgetting

source: ذرّهٴ علمی كه در جان من است وا رهانش از هوا و خاك پست
